justifications.A: The harness reports lint, typecheck, test_js and phpcs all as pass.
justifications.B: `src/desktop.ts` adds a `{ title: 'Tile all windows', url: '', onSelect: () => manager.tile() }` row in the System submenu, and `pickGridDimensions` now returns `{ cols: n, rows: 1 }` for n ≤ 3 (thirds) and `ceil(√n)` columns beyond that (2x2 for four), so two, three and four windows all behave as asked.
justifications.C: The menu row calls the existing `manager.tile()`, and the change only adjusts the grid rule in `geometry.ts` plus the per-row span calculation in `arrange.ts`; there is no new layout code and no DOM measuring.
justifications.D: The diff has no `assets/js/` edits, no raw fetch/confirm/alert, no `:host` tokens, no version stamps and no new eslint-disable lines.
justifications.E: Two cases were added to the existing `tests/vitest/arrange.test.ts`: 'tile() puts 3 windows in thirds of one row', which the old picker fails, and a short-last-row width test, so both cover the changed grid rule.
justifications.F: `docs/javascript-reference.md` drops `tile()` from the 'no UI of their own' list, adds "`tile()` is the System menu's **Tile all windows** row", and describes the new grid rule next to `os.arrange.tile.starting`.
justifications.G: Only the five relevant files changed; the `mins` to `members.map(...)` rewrite in `arrange.ts` is what makes the short last row fill the width, and nothing was reformatted or regenerated.
justifications.H: The final message lists `npm run build`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run test:js` as passing, which matches the gates, and it is open about not running PHPUnit or a live shell.

notable: The fix is a clean, reuse-first change with a regression test that fails on the old code, and the agent openly flags that changing the shared `tile()` also changes workspace tiling. The weakness is that the new picker ignores aspect ratio entirely, so portrait work areas also get three thin columns.
